events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the life and legacy of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas in September 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-seven years on from his tragic passing, Tupac's music still resonates. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today, we pay tribute to the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon in September 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix's Groundbreaking Sound
angles.copy: The guitar legend Jimi Hendrix is remembered today. Which of his groundbreaking tracks truly blew your mind?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road
events.blurb: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road', originally released in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Enduring Appeal
angles.copy: Still crossing that road! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' gets a nod today. What's your top track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since its UK single release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' remains a powerful call for peace and unity. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Today marks 25 years since Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film series since the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, the brilliant John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially known as 'The Beatles', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Impact
angles.copy: A true masterpiece! The Beatles' 'White Album' gets a nod today. What's your go-to track from its eclectic mix?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, the legendary Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since its release, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a significant shift in their sound. Which track best represents its brilliance?
